about: I'm a passionate MERN-stack developer with a strong foundation in modern web technologies. My journey began during my studies and has grown through internships and professional roles.
I specialize in building full-stack web applications using React.js, Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB — from modern React patterns on the frontend to API and database design on the backend.

Currently based in Surat, I'm actively seeking exciting opportunities in React.js development and MERN stack projects, particularly freelance and full-time roles where I can ship innovative web solutions.
